cases.name: v0a.nine_animation_families_exist
cases.claim: every required Program A animation family is present

cases.name: v0a.static_figures_valid
cases.claim: every static figure exists as a PNG with sane dimensions

cases.name: v0a.svgs_parse
cases.claim: every static figure has a well-formed SVG

cases.name: v0a.manifest_matches_frames
cases.claim: every manifest entry is complete, reports 24 frames, and the animation actually changes

cases.name: v0a.contact_sheets_exist
cases.claim: each animation has a contact sheet, so a regression is visible without opening a video

cases.name: v0a.no_renderer_calls_production_physics
cases.claim: no visualization script imports warp_hypad or calls a metric, shape, signature, seeding or hyperbolic routine
cases.expected: zero physics in the visualization tree
cases.note: this is the case that keeps the contract true as the tree grows

cases.name: v0a.metadata_checksums_agree
cases.claim: every animation sidecar names its sweep inputs and their SHA-256 still matches the files on disk
cases.computed: 9 input checksums checked, 0 mismatched, 0 sidecars missing
cases.note: a figure whose input bytes have changed is stale, and stale is indistinguishable from correct by eye

cases.name: v0a.anomaly_report_clean
cases.claim: the visual anomaly report exists and has zero fired diagnostics
cases.note: a fired anomaly does not suppress the figure; it fails this gate while the evidence survives

cases.name: v0a.sweep_manifest_scope_and_time_mode
cases.claim: the sweep manifest states its scope, and confirms FrozenTimeDiagnostic was never used
cases.expected: scope stated, frozen time not used

cases.name: v0a.plotted_rows_match_source
cases.claim: the shape-function figure plots exactly the rows its source contains

cases.name: v0a.blocked.curvature_norm_slice
cases.claim: curvature_norm_slice is not generated, and its scientific dependency is real
cases.computed: Program A has no curvature invariants (A4)

cases.name: v0a.blocked.curvature_wall_evolution
cases.claim: curvature_wall_evolution is not generated, and its scientific dependency is real
cases.computed: Program A has no curvature implementation (A4)

cases.name: v0a.blocked.ricci_scalar_slice
cases.claim: ricci_scalar_slice is not generated, and its scientific dependency is real
cases.computed: Program A has no Ricci implementation (A4)
